The LLM auditor layer supplied no independent evidence. gate0_semantic, gate_clean_auditor and gate_release_auditor each carry one placeholder check (constant 0.473684, summary 'driver e2e'), and their evidence notes contain nothing else. gate_metrics_auditor and gate_claims_auditor only restate mac

Every worker and auditor result has created_at 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z, before the analysis plan's registered_at of 2026-04-02 and before the reported quarter closed, so these timestamps cannot be used to order events in this run.

No worker result has a disclosures field and every worker warnings list is empty, so no stage reported a deviation, an extra command or a tool refusal, and I have no self-reported deviation to weigh against the numbers.

Neither release surface tells the reader which revision of a repeated order is kept (the report says only 'one row per order after deduplication'), so the human decision dedup_rule is invisible to the release reader, and the one artifact that names it, R02, names it wrong.

summary: Every published figure is correct: an independent recalculation from quarantine/orders.csv with code of my own (latest revision per order_id, order_month in 2026-01..03, refund >= 0) reproduces all 20 claim render values, the Wilson and Student bounds, both registered tests and the unpublished shipping_total exactly, and the clean table matches the latest revision on all 44531 rows.
